typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use Manrope for its soft, humanistic geometry. Use IBM Plex Sans for readable notes and body text. Tight letter spacing for headings (>32px). Labels should be uppercase with wide tracking.

visual enhancers.shadows: Very soft, ambient shadow (`shadow-sm` or `shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]`). Do not use harsh shadows.
visual enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`). Avoid sharp brutalist edges.

component name.name: Demo Case Creation Button
component name.style: pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), soft background (`bg-accent/10`), text (`text-accent`), subtle hover lift.
component name.usage: Instant demo case creation. Distinct from the primary 'Complete Form' button.

component name.name: Complete Form Dialog
component name.style: Shadcn Dialog. White background, generous padding (`p-8`). Progressive disclosure.
component name.usage: Detailed case creation form with patient history.

component name.name: Listening Workspace (Écoute)
component name.style: Minimalist panel, generous whitespace (`p-12`). Contains a subtle audio waveform visualizer.
component name.usage: Calm environment while the helper is actively listening or recording.

component name.name: Voice Session Summary (Compte-rendu vocal)
component name.style: Flat card, `bg-white`, `border-l-4 border-primary` to indicate AI-generated summary.

component name.name: Follow-up Status (Statut de suivi)
component name.style: Shadcn Badge components. Colors mapping to state (Green for 'Stable', Amber for 'Monitor', Grey for 'Archived').
component name.usage: At-a-glance status in the dashboard and case header.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B), but with generous padding. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6`.
grids.workspace_layout: Sidebar (col-span-3) + Main Workspace (col-span-9). Inside Main: Split notes (col-span-6) and summary (col-span-6).

layouts.overall: Sidebar-based navigation (predictable, low cognitive load). Mobile: bottom nav or hamburger.
layouts.private_notes_area: Distraction-free, large text area (Notion style). Left-aligned text, high line-height (`leading-loose`).

motion.transitions: Micro-interactions only. 300ms ease-in-out for hover states. Fade-in for content switching.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up (Y-axis 10px, opacity 0 to 1 over 0.5s) to feel gentle.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Deep slate on off-white.
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring (`focus:ring-primary/50`) for all inputs.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.

media.avatars: Use round (`rounded-full`) professional headshots. 1px border ring.
media.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Stroke width 1.5 for a lighter feel.

3d libraries.status: NOT REQUIRED. 3D models or heavy animations would detract from the calm, professional, and serious nature of a mental health dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Replace the existing 'Performance Pro' hacker theme in App.css and index.css with the 'Organic & Earthy' Light Theme.
Remove all dark mode gradients and neon borders.

Implement two distinct case creation actions: A 'Quick Demo' button that instantly populates a mocked case (use the provided avatars), and a 'Complete Form' button that opens a Shadcn Dialog with extensive patient detail fields.
For the 'Écoute' (Listening) section, design a calm visualizer (using standard CSS or Framer Motion bars, NOT a complex 3D library) centered in a large white card.
Place 'Notes privées' and 'Compte-rendu vocal' side-by-side or stacked in the workspace. Notes should look like a clean document, and the summary should clearly look AI-generated but reassuring.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively: Dialog, Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Badge, Card, Avatar.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, forms, and interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Prioritize progressive disclosure: hide secondary information until requested.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Use 2-3x more spacing (`p-6` to `p-12`) than typical density. Cramped designs cause cognitive overload, especially in healthcare.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters. Use Lucide icons.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Context First: Design is for a mental health helper (therapist/counselor). It must be a 'Calm, reassuring, and professional' environment.
Emotion First: Every design decision maps to trust and calm. Soft tones, clear hierarchy, no aggressive borders.
Alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content for readability. Center-align only major empty states.
Surface Strategy: Flat Solid surfaces. DO NOT use Glassmorphism for health apps—it feels cold and refracts data readability.
Grid Protocol: Use Grid Mode B (High Density) but soften it with wider gaps (`gap-6`) and larger padding.
